scene: You skate through the neon torii into the bustling Grand Transit Hub.
picture: Flat side view across the wide tiled hub platform. On the far left, a docked solar-sail junk floats in a water slip. The young Chinese woman in a red bomber jacket and roller skates stands left of centre. In the centre sits the maglev dragon train. On the right, a round cloud cable pod hangs ready.
shown: a gilded solar-sail junk moored at a glowing canal gate on the left
a maglev dragon train with open passenger doors waiting in the centre
a spherical cloud cable pod dangling open at a pylon on the right
